SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT. All people and places are fictional. Not a legal record.
‘SALE DEED
This Sale Deed is executed on 12/03/2023 at Harinagar, Uttar Pradesh
Date of Execution: 12/03/2023
BETWEEN Shri Ramesh Chandra Verma, S/o Late Shyam Lal Verma, R/o 44:Gandhi Marg,
Harinagar (hereinafter called the "VENDOR") -
AND Smt. Anita Sharma; W/o Vinod Sharma, R/o 12 Civil Lines, Harinagar (hereinafter called
the "VENDEE")
RECITALS
The Vendor purchased the said property from Suresh Prasad Gupta by a registered sale deed _
dated 05/08/2009, registered as Document No. 3341/2009, and has been in peaceful possession
since
The Vendor has agreed to sell the property described below for a total sale consideration of Rs
_ 45,00,000/- (Rupees in full), received by bank transfer. —
Stamp duty of Rs. 3,15,000/- has been paid through e-stamp certificate
SCHEDULE OF PROPERTY
Property Address: Plot No. 17, Block C, Lakshmi Nagar Extension, Tehsil Sadar, District
- Harinagar ॥ |
_ Khasra No. 245/2, Khata No. 118, total area 200 sq. yards
Boundaries of the property
North: 30 feet wide road
South: Plot No. 18 of Mohan Lal |
East: Plot No. 16 |
‘West Community Park
- COVENANTS
The Vendor has this day delivered vacant possession of the property to the Vendee
-The Vendor declares the property is free from all encumbrances, charges and mortgages
REGISTRATION DETAILS
Registered at the Office of the Sub-Registrar Harinagar-II. Document No. 2217/2023, Book No
. 1, Volume No. 4512, Pages 101 to 118
Date of Registration: 14/03/2023
Signed by the Vendor and the Vendee in the presence of witnesses.
